Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Authentication and user-account persistence backed by users.json.

Handles registration, login verification, admin user lifecycle (activate/deactivate/delete), and password hash updates. New registrations receive Roles.TA by default; passwords are stored via PasswordHasher (BCrypt with legacy plaintext fallback).

Not thread-safe: intended for single-threaded servlet request handling against one data directory.
